items.text: Related TNF notes: David Montgomery expected back; multiple Colts/Texans outs including Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring).
items.why: Off report / ruled; Harrison OUT hamstring.
items.implication: Montgomery lead or split; Collins/others targets up without MHJ.

items.text: Andy Reid on Kenneth Walker III (groin): getting better but 'don't want to do something stupid.' Levitan agrees playing him less than 100% is stupid, especially with huge Week 12 at BUF; Chiefs 15.5-pt favorites vs ARI.
items.why: Reid comments + Emmett Johnson monster Week 10; no rush with easy matchup and big game next.
items.implication: High chance sits again; monitor practice rest of week.
items.opportunity: Backup RB volume if OUT (Emmett Johnson lead)

items.text: NE loses Drake Maye, potentially for the season. Everything you need to know before Week 11 includes this note.
items.why: Ankle injury (possible fracture); bye week but long-term concern.
items.implication: Tommy DeVito or replacement; NE pass game downgrade.
items.opportunity: Backup QB stream, WR handcuffs if any

items.text: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield did not practice Wednesday due to a foot injury.
items.why: Foot/ankle strain from Week 9; trending toward sit per prior reports.
items.implication: Jalon Daniels likely starts vs DET; impacts TB pass catchers.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and elevated WR/TE usage if OUT

items.text: FULL CHUB(A) FOR MR. HUBBARD! Chuba Hubbard is my RB6 in my rest-of-season rankings.
items.why: Strong recent production and role security in CAR backfield.
items.implication: Hold/start confidently ROS; trade target up.

items.text: The window to return for IR is opening today for WRs Michael Pittman Jr, Roman Wilson... McCarthy said it’ll take evaluating them all week for Sunday vs Eagles.
items.why: IR return window opens; full week eval.
items.implication: Possible Week 11 return boosts PIT pass game.
items.opportunity: Pittman targets if active; else others

items.text: No IR for Jordan Addison, per coach Kevin O’Connell.
items.why: Thumb injury but coach confirms no IR designation.
items.implication: Could return sooner than multi-week IR; monitor practice.

items.text: And Joe Milton starts at QB. (Sean Mannion remains play-caller).
items.why: Hurts season-ending (blood clots context); Milton elevated.
items.implication: PHI offense efficiency drop; impacts Saquon/WRs/TE.

items.text: In first game with Kirk Cousins, Vikings set a season-high in Pass Rate Over Expectation. Kevin O'Connell wants to throw, and throw a lot. Confirms earlier PROE notes.
items.why: Season-high PROE with Cousins; O'Connell scheme preference.
items.implication: Boost Jefferson/Addison routes/targets ROS; playoff DvP favorable.
items.opportunity: High route volume, targets for WRs/TE

items.text: Coke heads, I’m sorry. I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jalen Coker. The talent is there. The fantasy production has not been.
items.why: Talent vs lack of fantasy production.

items.text: I am CLOSING IT OUT on Jaylen Waddle. The target share is nice. The production is not.
items.why: Target share present but fantasy production lacking despite role.
items.implication: Sell/drop in shallower leagues; fade weekly.

items.text: Lions placed EDGE Aidan Hutchinson on injured reserve and activated S Kerby Joseph from Reserve/PUP.
items.implication: DET pass rush weaker; slight boost opposing QBs/offense.

items.text: We have JT ahead of Chase Brown in the ROS150 half-PPR. In full-PPR, Brown would be further ahead.
items.why: Updated ROS Top-150; format-dependent (half vs full PPR).
items.implication: Trade value edge to JT in half-PPR; Brown closer in PPR.

items.text: Kaelon Black is available in 61% of Yahoo leagues. He has 60+ scrimmage yards in three straight games, has scored twice in his past three, and remains a viable flex even with Christian McCaffrey healthy. All RBs targeting on waivers.
